# proxmox_guest_mtunnel_websocket (Data Source)

Resolves a migration tunnel websocket through `/nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/mtunnelwebsocket`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_mtunnel_websocket" "w" {
  type   = "qemu"
  node   = "pve-1"
  vmid   = 300
  socket = "/run/qemu-server/300.mtunnel"
  ticket = "PVETUNNEL:..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `socket` (String)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `result` (String)
